before: The editor measured a missing font family, and a character that a font lacks, in a font that the browser picked. PDF export used its own fallback faces.
after: The editor and the exports apply one set of font fallback rules. Each editor asks its own font host for the fallback faces that its text needs.
reason: Fonts are local to each client. The change adds no operation, no shared field, and no awareness state, so released clients share rooms as before.
